xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4343: Operator-grant labels (`released`, `auto-merge`, `hold-for-uat`) honored only from a non-agent actor

plan.title: Operator-grant labels (`released`, `auto-merge`, `hold-for-uat`) honored only from a non-agent actor
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Pickup (`released`) and merge policy (`auto-merge`, `hold-for-uat`) read label presence only, and agents run `gh` with the operator's token, so an agent-applied grant label is indistinguishable from the operator's. The Flywheel runs as a conversation (`conv-flywheel`), and conversation launchers get no `gh` shim at all (`src/lib/launcher-generator.ts:381`, `spawnMode !== 'conversation'`).
narratives.Proposal: Make the `gh` shim the load-bearing layer. (1) Add a POSIX-sh grant-label deny block to the shim built by `buildGhShimLines` in `src/lib/launcher-git-guard.ts`, enabled for every agent pane; it refuses `gh issue|pr edit|create` label flags and `gh api` label-carrier writes naming `released`, `auto-merge` or `hold-for-uat` (add or remove), before the ledger append, with no bypass env. (2) Export `buildConversationGhShimLines(id, denyGrantLabels)` that writes a gh-only shim at `<OVERDECK_HOME>/conversations/<id>/git-guard/gh`. (3) Add `LauncherConfig.ghShim` and emit it for `spawnMode: 'conversation'` in `launcher-generator.ts` with zero net line growth. (4) `spawnConversationSession` sets `ghShim: { id: tmuxSession, denyGrantLabels: tmuxSession === FLYWHEEL_CONVERSATION_SESSION }`. (5) Document the rule in MERGE-WORKFLOW, PIPELINE-GATES, auto-merge.mdx and the pan-flywheel skill. Full detail, reference shell code and test tables are in `.pan/drafts/PAN-4343.md`.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No events-API actor check (`GET /repos/{o}/{r}/issues/{n}/events`); it names the operator while agents share the operator token.
- No routing of agent `gh` writes through the GitHub App installation token.
- No blocking of absolute-path `/usr/bin/gh`, `gh api --input <file>` bodies, or GraphQL `addLabelsToLabelable`/`removeLabelsFromLabelable` (label node IDs); cheap-path prevention only.
- No distinction between lane, `pan handoff`, or other agent-driven conversations and operator conversations: every `conv-*` other than `conv-flywheel` passes.
- No git guard for conversations.
- No new `GitHubQuotaCaller` value; conversation calls log as `caller: 'agent'` with `agent: <conv id>`.
- No change to how pickup (`pickup.ts`) or auto-merge eligibility read labels.
- No deny for labels outside the closed set (`vetoed`, `parked`, `ready`, `objection`, etc.).
- No bypass environment variable for the deny (neither `OVERDECK_GH_METERED` nor `OVERDECK_PAN_GIT_OP` skips it).
- No raise of any `scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt` cap; `launcher-generator.ts` must stay at or under 1000 lines.

autoDecisions.summary: Refuse both adding and removing grant labels, not only adding.
autoDecisions.rationale: Removing `hold-for-uat` is itself the merge grant, and the pan-flywheel skill already says the loop never adds or removes `released`; denying both directions on the closed set is the consistent reading of 'honored only from a non-agent actor'.

autoDecisions.summary: Include `gh issue create` / `gh pr create` label flags and `gh api` issue create/patch label fields, not only `edit` and the labels endpoint.
autoDecisions.rationale: Creating an issue already labeled `released` bypasses the pickup gate exactly like editing one; leaving it open would make the deny trivially sidestepped on the cheap path.

autoDecisions.summary: `gh api` is matched on label-carrier arguments (`*labels*=*` fields or `issues/*/labels/<name>` paths) plus gh's effective method, instead of any argument containing a label name.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matching any argument would refuse ordinary issue comments that mention the word 'released'; the carrier rule was run under dash against every test case during planning.

The launcher prelude and `pan restart` (`src/cli/commands/restart.ts:245`) strip PATH segments ending in `/git-guard`; any other name could leak the Flywheel's deny shim into the dashboard server PATH and silently break the operator's Release button (`label-ops.ts` swallows gh errors).

autoDecisions.summary: Use an explicit `LauncherConfig.ghShim` field set by conversation-runtime rather than inferring from `managedStateKey` inside the generator.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the flywheel identity decision in the one module that knows the conversation, avoids a flywheel import in the generator, and leaves existing conversation inline snapshots unchanged.

autoDecisions.summary: Log conversation `gh` calls as `caller: 'agent'` with `agent: <conv id>`.
autoDecisions.rationale: Adding a contracts enum value is out of scope; the `agent` field already identifies the conversation.
